pages.text: Deconstructs life samples into $(bold)gene sequences$() - the start of genetic engineering.$(br2)Only samples with $(bold)purity ≥25$() fit the input slot; lower ones belong to the Potion Table.$(br)Each run costs $(bold)5,000 life energy$() and takes 5 seconds.

$(bold)Success rate scales with sample purity$(): 70% at purity 25, 95% at purity 100, linear in between.$(br2)Success keeps the $(bold)purity$() in the sequence; failure loses the sample.$(br2)$(2)Purify before analyzing - high purity pays off.$()
